title: Contract Validator
description: Verify that a set of Rust source files compiles to the exact code deployed on-chain — useful for auditing closed-source contracts whose source isn't published. Upload the project, and get a match verdict.
invalidAddress: Enter a valid Klever contract address (klv1…)
versionFieldAutofillHint: Auto-filled from your project's ABI when available.
wasmOptVersionFieldHint: Optional — leave empty to compare unoptimized, then optimized.
kscVersionTooltip:
The Klever smart-contract build toolchain (ksc) version.
• Run: ksc --version
• Or read output/*.abi.json → buildInfo.framework.version
Auto-filled from your project ABI when available.
rustVersionTooltip:
The Rust toolchain used to compile the contract.
• Run: rustc --version (or rustup show)
• Or check rust-toolchain.toml
• Or read output/*.abi.json → buildInfo.rustc.version
Auto-filled from your project ABI when available.
wasmOptVersionTooltip:
The Binaryen wasm-opt version applied to the compiled WASM.
• Run: wasm-opt --version (prints e.g. "wasm-opt version 116")
Optional: leave empty to compare the unoptimized build first, then the default wasm-opt.
dropMessage: Drag & drop your project .zip here, or click to browse
fileSelected: Selected: {{name}} — click or drop to replace
versionsAutofillHint: KSC & Rust versions are filled in automatically from the project's ABI when available.
parsingVersions: Reading KSC & Rust versions from the project…
ownerModalText: As the contract owner you can validate it for free on the contract's page — and choose whether to publish the full source (open-source) or list only the ABI. The paid validation here is for anyone who just wants to check a match.
connectWalletHint: Connect your Klever wallet to pay and run the validation.
feeNote: A fee of {{fee}} KLV is charged per validation. You'll confirm the payment in your wallet.
historyEmpty: No checks yet for this wallet. Run one above and it will appear here.
